title: Stage dispatch and settlement
summary: A run reads succeeded only after every required member closes together. Settlement refuses before writing any member when a required member is not cleared or a prepare refuses, and names each blocker, open done-gate QA requirements included. The refusal carries `run_settlement_blocked`; the driver stops at once with exit 4 and that recovery, retrying only a write that got no answer, and a re-drive does not re-stamp members already done.
